lines.en: label church25:
scene clearnightsky
Again, I find myself making questionable decisions and wandering off in directions I’m well aware I should avoid.
lines.zh: 又一次，我发现自己在做着可疑的决定，朝着我很清楚该避开的方向信步走去。

lines.en: I have never cared for gods or gospel...nor prayer, priests, or penance — but my affinity for mysterious creatures and those with blue eyes seems to outweigh that.
lines.zh: 我向来不在乎什么神明或福音……也不在乎祈祷、神父或苦修——可我对神秘生物、对那些蓝眼睛的女孩的偏爱，似乎盖过了这一切。

lines.en: I am a simple man- cut from the cloth of a lecher’s bed sheets and doused in chloroform so that all I come into contact with will begin to fade out before I can learn to fade in.
lines.zh: 我是个简单的人——裁自好色之徒的床单，又被浸透了氯仿，好让我所接触到的一切，在我学会淡入之前就开始淡出。

lines.en: It’s hot again. Customarily so. Which means I need to customarily inform you of that so you understand the stage and setting and don’t feel left out as I become further immersed in tonight’s selection.
lines.zh: 又热了。照例地热。这意味着我得照例向你通报一声，好让你明白此刻的舞台与布景，在我愈发沉浸于今晚的这一出时，不至于觉得自己被排除在外。

lines.en: While it may seem like we’re in this together, we both know I’m the only one dancing in the halls of harm’s way.
lines.zh: 虽然看起来我们像是并肩同行，但你我都清楚，唯一在险境的厅堂里起舞的人是我。

lines.en: You can’t see the portraits that line the corridors. You can’t hear the faint half-melodies of an untuned piano ringing out in the distance — nor the hum of buried machines or whispering sky.
lines.zh: 你看不见走廊两侧挂满的画像。你听不见远处一架走调的钢琴奏出的微弱半段旋律——也听不见被埋藏的机器的嗡鸣，或是天空的低语。

lines.en: Only I can, because {i}I{/i} have been ordained to feel or hear or taste or experience these things all so that, one day, when I leave this place, I will be full of lingering sensations that will be fed to something bigger.
lines.zh: 只有我能，因为{i}我{/i}被注定要去感受、聆听、品尝、经历这一切，好让有朝一日我离开这个地方时，浑身装满挥之不去的感受，再被喂给某个更庞大的存在。

lines.en: I mention not the gods, for I’ve already told you how I feel about them.
lines.zh: 我不提那些神明，因为我对它们的看法早就说过了。

lines.en: But what I {i}do{/i} mention is still lost...so I have followed my legs for a chance to find it.
lines.zh: 可我{i}确实{/i}提到的那样东西，依旧下落不明……所以我跟着自己的双腿走，只为有机会找到它。

lines.en: Why do the trees still grow?
lines.zh: 为什么树木还在生长？

lines.en: Why does my cock still feast on the blood of my body and gorge itself on the fruits of my heart?
lines.zh: 为什么我的鸡巴还在享用我身体的血，还在狼吞虎咽我心脏的果实？

lines.en: Why do those fruits taste so good?
lines.zh: 为什么那些果实尝起来如此甘美？

lines.en: scene yasueyesagain1
The answer is that they don’t.
lines.zh: 答案是：它们并不甘美。

lines.en: They’ve simply fallen at our feet and are too conveniently placed to avoid biting into.
lines.zh: 它们只是恰好落在我们脚边，位置太顺手，让人无法不去咬上一口。

lines.en: You wouldn’t willingly go hungry, would you?
lines.zh: 你总不会甘愿饿着吧？

lines.en: I bet you’d cannibalize someone dear to you if it meant keeping yourself alive.
lines.zh: 我敢打赌，只要能让自己活下去，你连至亲的人都吃得下去。

lines.en: I know I would.
lines.zh: 我知道我会。

lines.en: And perhaps I already do.
lines.zh: 也许我已经在这么做了。

lines.en: Just I eat from the inside out because saving the shells makes for a better collection than memories alone ever will.
lines.zh: 只不过我是从里往外吃，因为留下外壳，比单靠回忆更能凑成一份像样的收藏。

lines.en: For the nth time, I am being followed — and this fact alone makes me further question everything the girl I’m here to see has ever said to me.
lines.zh: 第无数次了，我被人跟着——光是这个事实，就让我对那个我来这儿要见的女孩说过的每一句话都更加起疑。

lines.en: This is supposed to be a safe place, isn’t it?
lines.zh: 这里本该是个安全的地方，不是吗？

lines.en: The door is only meant to open for those it deems worthy, isn’t it?
lines.zh: 那扇门只该为它认定配得上的人而开，不是吗？

lines.en: I wonder if the heavens are short on help.
lines.zh: 我在想，天堂是不是缺人手了。

lines.en: And then I wonder why they won’t just open the gates to let it in.
lines.zh: 接着我又想，他们为什么不干脆打开大门，把它放进来。

lines.en: There is something for me here.
lines.zh: 这里有属于我的东西。

lines.en: Something for me to take.
lines.zh: 有东西等着我去拿走。

lines.en: But how am I meant to find it if I can only see half of the room?
lines.zh: 可如果我只能看见半个房间，又叫我从何找起？

lines.en: : Blessed be those who burn what they love...And surrender their senses to God up above.
lines.zh: : 焚烧所爱的人有福了……并把感官交给在上的上帝。

lines.en: : Blessed be those who sever their ties...so summer can flourish and winter can die.
lines.zh: : 斩断牵绊的人有福了……好让夏天繁盛，让冬天死去。

lines.en: : Blessed be spring...and autumn and more. Blessed be all that we wish to restore.
lines.zh: : 春天有福了……秋天以及更多也有福了。我们所愿复原的一切，都有福了。

lines.en: : Blessed be sinners...and those who fall through.
lines.zh: : 罪人有福了……还有那些坠落的人。

lines.en: : But most of all, Akira...Blessed be you.
lines.zh: : 但最要紧的是，Akira……你有福了。

lines.en: scene yasueyesagain2
: How did you-
lines.zh: : 你怎么——

lines.en: : He told me.
lines.zh: : 是祂告诉我的。

lines.en: : He tells me all sorts of things. And it is on nights like tonight that He tells me the most.
lines.zh: : 祂会告诉我各式各样的事。而在像今晚这样的夜晚，祂告诉我的最多。

lines.en: : Did you bring your own roll of duct tape? Or would you like to borrow some of mine?
lines.zh: : 你自己带胶带了吗？还是想借我的用用？

lines.en: : There’s plenty to go around. Just ask Muriel and you’ll be right beside me in no time at all.
lines.zh: : 管够的。只要跟 Muriel 说一声，你转眼就能坐到我旁边来。

lines.en: scene yasueyesagain3
: I’m not going to tape my eyes shut, Yasu...Even {i}if{/i} you keep managing to...figure out things you’re not supposed to know.
lines.zh: : 我不会把眼睛用胶带贴住的，Yasu……{i}就算{/i}你总能……弄明白那些你本不该知道的事。

lines.en: : What is the reason you hide your name?
lines.zh: : 你隐瞒名字的理由是什么？

lines.en: : Is that {i}you{/i} asking? Or your weird, eyeball god?
lines.zh: : 这是{i}你{/i}在问？还是你那个古怪的眼球神？

lines.en: : There is nothing I ask for myself. I am but a vessel for all He wishes to know. And His interest in you grows deeper by the day.
lines.zh: : 我从不为自己求问任何事。我不过是祂想知道的一切所寄居的器皿。而祂对你的兴趣，与日俱增。

lines.en: : Yet, now more than ever before, your distaste for the unburning light grows fiercer despite all that has happened to you.
lines.zh: : 然而此刻比以往任何时候都更强烈的是，尽管你身上发生了那么多事，你对那不灭之光的厌恶却愈发炽烈。

lines.en: : Would it not be easier to surrender yourself altogether? Will breaking the chains that bind the false you to the real one truly be so terrible?
lines.zh: : 干脆把自己整个交出去，不是更轻松吗？斩断那把虚假的你与真实的你绑在一起的锁链，真的有那么可怕吗？

lines.en: : Is it because you feel as if you can’t exist without them? Because, if that is the case, He wants you to know that you can.
lines.zh: : 是因为你觉得没有了它们就无法存在吗？因为如果真是这样，祂想让你知道，你可以的。

lines.en: : And that He can make even the most hideous of shadows disappear by mixing them into your primary body...so it all merges into a single box with perfect corners.
lines.zh: : 也让你知道，即便是再丑陋不过的阴影，祂也能把它揉进你的本体之中，让它彻底消失……好让一切融为一个棱角完美的盒子。

lines.en: : You can be more than you are now...but not while you are being followed. There is someone else who deserves that honor. And whatever it is that is tied to you should be consumed in its entirety.
lines.zh: : 你可以成为比现在更多的东西……但不是在你被跟着的时候。另有其人配得上那份荣光。而与你绑在一起的那东西，应该被整个吞吃干净。

lines.en: scene yasueyesagain4
: Is something...actually following me? Because I’ve been getting these strange feelings lately that-
lines.zh: : 真的有什么东西……在跟着我吗？因为我最近一直有一种奇怪的感觉——

lines.en: : We’re all followed by something- be it ghosts of the past or glimpses of the future. Which is why we must sever all unneeded ties...so we can better envelop ourselves in the present.
lines.zh: : 我们都被某种东西跟着——或是过去的幽灵，或是未来的闪影。所以我们必须斩断一切不必要的牵绊……好让自己更彻底地裹进当下。

lines.en: : For only then will we notice when we are called upon.
lines.zh: : 因为只有这样，我们才会在被召唤的时刻有所察觉。

lines.en: scene yasueyesagain3
: Gotcha. So it was just another generic, religious generalization after all.
lines.zh: : 明白了。说到底又是一句笼统的宗教套话罢了。

lines.en: : The Church of New Hope is no generic religion, Sensei. It is the one true path — and all who do not follow it are simply dooming themselves.
lines.zh: : 新希望教会可不是什么泛泛的宗教，Sensei。它是唯一的正道——凡不追随它的，都只是在自取灭亡。

lines.en: : You realize that’s basically what every other major religion thinks as well, right?
lines.zh: : 你也知道，其他各大宗教基本上也都是这么想的吧？

lines.en: : It is not my place to {i}realize{/i} things when all I could ever want to know is simply injected into me in the moments I’m connected to Him.
lines.zh: : 我与祂相连的那些瞬间，我想知道的一切都只是被直接注入体内，我又有什么立场去{i}明白{/i}什么。

lines.en: : But if it is other {i}religions{/i} you would like to speak about, please sit. You’ve arrived at the perfect time.
lines.zh: : 不过如果你想谈的是别的{i}宗教{/i}，那就请坐吧。你来得正是时候。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? Is this your annual meeting to discuss how you’re going to promote yourselves and convert all of the “non-believers?”
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？这是你们的年会吗，讨论怎么自我宣传、把那些“不信者”全都感化过来？

lines.en: : They will convert themselves when they realize they need to.
lines.zh: : 等他们意识到自己需要的时候，自然会自己归信。

lines.en: : What we are doing today is reaffirming our love for Him and reminding ourselves of why it is He we follow in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我们今天所做的，是重申我们对祂的爱，并提醒自己，我们追随的究竟为何是祂。

lines.en: scene yasueyesagain5
: Another shift in seasons approaches — and with that marks the coming of six more months of dormancy.
lines.zh: : 又一次季节的更替将近——随之而来的，是长达六个月的蛰伏。

lines.en: : Here’s...hoping you bought a heavier jacket, I guess?
lines.zh: : 那……我猜，希望你买了件厚点的外套？

lines.en: : You’d think I would need one, yes? As summer and winter are all we have here, we transition from one extreme to the next — instantaneously at that.
lines.zh: : 你会觉得我需要一件，对吧？我们这儿只有夏和冬，从一个极端直接跳到另一个极端——而且是瞬间完成。

lines.en: : But do you know {i}why{/i} things are the way they are?
lines.zh: : 可你{i}知道{/i}事情为何会变成这样吗？

lines.en: : Do you know why we do not have three months of temporary stasis in between those two extremes, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你知道为什么在这两个极端之间，没有三个月的中间歇止吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : It is because autumn and spring have been taken from us.
lines.zh: : 因为秋天和春天被人从我们这里夺走了。

lines.en: scene yasueyesagain6
: Taken?...
: Consumed! By those who wish for a fraction of the omnipotence He possesses! And it is {i}we{/i} who are forced to suffer due to their fruitless pursuit of untapped power!
lines.zh: : 是被吞吃了！被那些妄图分得祂全能之万一的人！而因他们徒劳地追逐尚未开采的力量，被迫承受苦果的是{i}我们{/i}！

lines.en: : The world we love is only the world we {i}hate{/i} as a result of needless tampering with the rules and systems that guide us!
lines.zh: : 我们所爱的这个世界，正因为有人多余地动了那些引导我们的规则与系统，才变成了我们所{i}憎恨{/i}的世界！

lines.en: : Picture it! The reds and yellows of the fall! The pinks and blues of springtime! It is as if color itself has been taken from us!
lines.zh: : 想想看！秋日的红与黄！春日的粉与蓝！简直像是色彩本身被人从我们这里夺走了！

lines.en: scene yasueyesagain7
: Which leaves black...
lines.zh: : 于是只剩下黑……

lines.en: : And {i}white.{/i}
lines.zh: : 还有{i}白{/i}。

lines.en: : One is everything. One is nothing.
lines.zh: : 一个是一切。一个是虚无。

lines.en: : But their simultaneous existence does not cancel anything out. It’s just the opposite.
lines.zh: : 可它们同时存在，并不会相互抵消。恰恰相反。

lines.en: : An endless game of tug of war between two forces we can not see. One everything. One nothing. And you would expect everything to win, would you not?
lines.zh: : 两股我们看不见的力量之间，是一场永无止境的拔河。一个是一切，一个是虚无。你会以为一切会赢，不是吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...
: I guess?
lines.zh: : 大概吧？

lines.en: : There is a third element to this game of tug of war.
lines.zh: : 这场拔河还有第三个要素。

lines.en: : Do you know what it is?
lines.zh: : 你知道那是什么吗？

lines.en: scene yasueyesagain8
: I have absolutely no idea...
lines.zh: : 我完全一头雾水……

lines.en: : It is the {i}rope.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是{i}绳子{/i}。

lines.en: : Right, yeah. That explains everything.
lines.zh: : 对，是是是。这就全解释通了呢。

lines.en: : It explains nothing...and there is no way you’ll ever understand at all if you approach my message with doubt.
lines.zh: : 它什么也解释不了……而且只要你带着怀疑来听我的话，你就永远不可能真正明白。

lines.en: scene yasueyesagain9
: Fine...Go ahead.
lines.zh: : 好吧……你继续。

lines.en: : Black...White...And all that lies between.
lines.zh: : 黑……白……以及介于两者之间的一切。

lines.en: : These are the three great divines — but only one can be the {i}greatest.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这就是三位伟大的神圣——但其中只有一位能成为{i}最伟大{/i}的。

lines.en: : Those of us who seek the truth and gaze upon this never ending battle will side with the right or the left as those are the two fighting the hardest.
lines.zh: : 我们这些追寻真理、凝视这场永不终结之战的人，会站在左边或右边，因为那是打得最凶的两方。

lines.en: : What they can not seem to grasp is that there’s danger in what lies between.
lines.zh: : 他们似乎始终无法领会的是，夹在中间的那个东西里藏着危险。

lines.en: : If the rope were to snap, who would be the winner? The one with the largest piece? The one who keeps their feet planted after the tear?
lines.zh: : 如果绳子崩断，谁会是赢家？是抢到最长那截的人？是断裂之后仍站稳脚跟的人？

lines.en: scene yasueyesagain10
: Or would no one win?
lines.zh: : 还是说，谁也赢不了？

lines.en: : Would the game simply begin again...with a brand new rope?
lines.zh: : 这场游戏会不会只是重新开始……换上一根全新的绳子？

lines.en: : Again, I have no idea. None of this ever makes sense to me.
lines.zh: : 还是那句话，我毫无头绪。这些东西我从来就没听懂过。

lines.en: scene yasueyesagain11
: That is because you don’t want it to!
lines.zh: : 那是因为你根本不想懂！

lines.en: : You, a child {i}born{/i} to someone who understood, should understand if anyone!
lines.zh: : 你，一个由{i}懂{/i}的人所生的孩子，若说有谁该懂，那就是你！

lines.en: scene yasueyesagain12
: What?...
: The rope has a mind of its own! It chooses when it tears and lures those who grip it into believing the outcome is not predetermined!
lines.zh: : 那根绳子有自己的意志！它自己决定何时断裂，还诱使握着它的人相信结局并非早已注定！

lines.en: : Even the most perfect, amazing, divine entities are not without those who would wish away their love! And it is up to us, the children, to tell the world of this!
lines.zh: : 即便是最完美、最非凡、最神圣的存在，也免不了有人盼着把祂们的爱抹去！而把这番话告诉世界的责任，落在了我们这些孩子身上！

lines.en: : To preach about the injustices of braided horsehair and carve out a hole in the world so the colors will have a place to return to once the time has come to reclaim them! And that time is approaching!
lines.zh: : 去宣讲编起来的马鬃所犯下的不公，在世界上凿出一个洞，好让色彩在收复它们的时刻到来时有处可归！而那个时刻正在逼近！

lines.en: : The dawning of a new season is upon us, but which one will it be?! One of the two we already know?!
lines.zh: : 新季节的黎明已经降临在我们头上，可那会是哪个季节？！是我们已知的两个之一？！

lines.en: : {i}Or a third one?...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}还是第三个？……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}A new one?...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}一个全新的？……{/i}

lines.en: : One that no one sees coming but {i}me...{/i}For it is I who understands. It is I who will sing His songs to the choir of sinners and sodomites! Only then, will everyone know to believe me!
lines.zh: : 一个除了{i}我{/i}谁也预见不到的季节……因为明白的人是我。将祂的歌献给罪人与所多玛人组成的唱诗班的人是我！到那时，所有人都会知道该相信我！

lines.en: : Yasu, what...what were you saying about my birth just now?
lines.zh: : Yasu，你刚才……你刚才说的关于我出生的那些话，是什么意思？

lines.en: scene yasueyesagain13
: That you are the product of something wonderful.
lines.zh: : 说你是一桩美好之事的产物。

lines.en: : You learned to crawl in the light of someone who understood the {i}importance{/i} of that light.
lines.zh: : 你是在某个懂得那光之{i}重要{/i}的人的光里，学会爬行的。

lines.en: : If you listen closely, you’ll hear her voice.
lines.zh: : 如果你仔细听，你会听见她的声音。

lines.en: : She whispers your name. Reminds you of a time when things were better. Before that light began to dim and you were forced to crawl in the dark instead.
lines.zh: : 她低声唤着你的名字。提醒你曾经有过的、一切都更好的那段时光。在那光开始黯淡、你被迫改在黑暗中爬行之前。

lines.en: : If I had met you back then, I would have loved you.
lines.zh: : 如果那时我就遇见了你，我会爱你的。

lines.en: : I would have given you the care you needed instead of allowing you to scamper off into the wrong side of everything.
lines.zh: : 我会给你所需要的照料，而不是任由你蹦跳着跑进一切事物的错误那一面。

lines.en: : I would have been your mother Mary, and you would have been the fruit of my virgin womb — bathed in frankincense & myrrh and blessed by everyone around you as a true son of God.
lines.zh: : 我会成为你的圣母马利亚，而你会成为我贞洁子宫所结的果实——沐浴在乳香与没药之中，被身边所有人祝颂为真正的神之子。

lines.en: : But it is not too late.
lines.zh: : 但现在还不算太晚。

lines.en: : I can still show you who you are.
lines.zh: : 我仍能让你看见真正的你。

lines.en: : I can reveal the voice of the one who follows you.
lines.zh: : 我能揭示那个跟着你的存在的声音。

lines.en: : All you need to do is take my hand.
lines.zh: : 你只需要握住我的手。

lines.en: : I will be your shepherd.
lines.zh: : 我会做你的牧者。

lines.en: : No. I don’t believe you. This is all just...mindless rambling. You’re insane. You’ve been brainwashed by some crazy neo-religion that’s taken over the {i}real{/i} you. This isn’t who you actually are.
lines.zh: : 不。我不信你。这一切都只是……没有意义的胡言乱语。你疯了。你被某个疯狂的新兴宗教洗了脑，它夺走了{i}真正的{/i}你。你本来不是这个样子的。

lines.en: : But it is.
lines.zh: : 可这就是我。

lines.en: : And the amount of proof at my disposal would shock even you — who has seen it all several times over.
lines.zh: : 而我手里的证据之多，就连你——一个已经把一切都看过好几遍的人——都会为之震惊。

lines.en: : You can’t do anything for me that I can’t do for myself.
lines.zh: : 你能替我做的，我自己也做得到。

lines.en: : I can. But only with His assistance.
lines.zh: : 我做得到。但只有在祂的帮助之下。

lines.en: : See this side of the world with me.
lines.zh: : 和我一起，看看世界的这一面。

lines.en: : And make me yours so that one more child will learn to crawl in the light instead of suffocating in the dark or being strangled by the rope.
lines.zh: : 并且让我成为你的，好让又有一个孩子学会在光里爬行，而不是在黑暗中窒息、或被那根绳子勒死。

lines.en: : Yasu-
lines.zh: : Yasu——

lines.en: : Return.
lines.zh: : 回来吧。

lines.en: : Return where? What-
lines.zh: : 回到哪里？什么——

lines.en: scene yasueyesagain14
: Where am I?...
lines.zh: : 这是哪儿？……

lines.en: scene yasueyesagain15
: Somewhere only He can take you.
lines.zh: : 一个只有祂能带你去的地方。

lines.en: : Breathe in deeply...and fill your lungs with the nostalgic air you’d wake up to every single day before you lost touch with the meaning of this world.
lines.zh: : 深深地吸气……让你的肺装满那种怀旧的空气，在你还没与这个世界的意义失联之前，你每天醒来时所呼吸的，就是它。

lines.en: : I ask...does this seem like a callous gesture to you? Or does it look more like a present from a righteous god who simply wants you to feel as if you belong?
lines.zh: : 我想问……这在你看来像是一种冷酷的施舍？还是更像一位公义之神送来的礼物——祂不过想让你觉得自己有所归属？

lines.en: : All of this and more is what you’ll see with me.
lines.zh: : 这一切、以及更多，都是你跟着我就能看见的。

lines.en: : Yasu...how are you even...
lines.zh: : Yasu……你到底是怎么……

lines.en: : How am I what?
lines.zh: : 我怎么什么？

lines.en: : How are you...doing this?
lines.zh: : 你……是怎么做到的？

lines.en: : The answer to that is simple.
lines.zh: : 这个问题的答案很简单。

lines.en: scene yasueyesagain16
: I’m not.
lines.zh: : 我没有。

lines.en: : You just think I am.
lines.zh: : 你只是以为我做到了。

lines.en: : And you only think that because, deep down, you believe.
lines.zh: : 而你之所以这么以为，是因为在你心底，你是信的。

lines.en: scene yasueyesagain17
: Deep down, you know that you are special.
lines.zh: : 在你心底，你知道自己是特别的。

lines.en: : You know that the visions you have are far more than just illusions.
lines.zh: : 你知道你所见的那些异象，远不止是幻觉而已。

lines.en: : You know that the world you’re in is not one of logic — but something different.
lines.zh: : 你知道你所处的这个世界并不遵循逻辑——而是别的什么东西。

lines.en: : And you know that I know more about it than you.
lines.zh: : 你也知道，关于它，我懂得比你多。

lines.en: : With that said, what excuse will you come up with to deny me once more?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，这一次你又要找什么借口来拒绝我？

lines.en: : How will you reject the word of God when it clings to the back of your throat, desperate to escape?
lines.zh: : 当上帝的话语黏在你喉咙深处、拼命想要冲出来时，你要怎么拒绝它？

lines.en: : I will be your shepherd.
lines.zh: : 我会做你的牧者。

lines.en: : I will help you regain what it is you’ve lost...and assist you in obtaining more than you’ve ever wanted along the way.
lines.zh: : 我会帮你找回你失去的东西……并在这条路上，帮你得到比你曾想要的更多的东西。

lines.en: : The rope is fraying, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 绳子正在磨损，Sensei。

lines.en: : Which side will you be on once it snaps?
lines.zh: : 它崩断的那一刻，你会站在哪一边？

lines.en: : And who will you believe in when everyone {i}else{/i} you trust betrays you?
lines.zh: : 当你所信任的{i}其他{/i}所有人都背叛你时，你又会去信谁？

lines.en: : Will you walk away again?
lines.zh: : 你又要转身走开吗？

lines.en: : Or will you sit with me and bask in His glory?
lines.zh: : 还是留下来与我同坐，沐浴在祂的荣光里？

lines.en: scene yasueyesagain18
: Yasu...
lines.zh: : Yasu……

lines.en: : Yes?
: I don’t believe in God...
lines.zh: : 我不信上帝……

lines.en: : I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : But everything would make more sense if you did...and {i}that{/i} is what you’re after.
lines.zh: : 可如果你信，一切都会合理得多……而{i}那{/i}正是你想要的。

lines.en: : Time is running out.
lines.zh: : 时间不多了。

lines.en: : And you will need somewhere to hide when your world begins to crumble.
lines.zh: : 当你的世界开始崩塌时，你会需要一个藏身之处。

lines.en: : This will be that place for you.
lines.zh: : 这里就会是那个地方。

lines.en: : And with your help, He will rise again.
lines.zh: : 而有了你的帮助，祂将再度升起。

lines.en: : And...{i}without{/i} my help?...
lines.zh: : 那……{i}没有{/i}我的帮助呢？……

lines.en: : What would happen then?
lines.zh: : 那会发生什么？

lines.en: : Yasu?...
lines.zh: : Yasu？……

lines.en: : Will you sit?
lines.zh: : 你会坐下吗？

lines.en: : Or will you walk?
lines.zh: : 还是你要走？

lines.en: scene yasueyesagain19
: Heheh....ahahehah......heaahehahehahheuhuhehehe!
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……啊哈哈哈………嘻哈哈哈嘿嘿呵呃呵呵呵！

lines.en: : Just to clarify, I’m not agreeing to join your church. I just...I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t interested in hearing a little more of...{i}your{/i} side of things.
lines.zh: : 先说清楚，我可没答应加入你们的教会。我只是……如果我说我对多听一点{i}你{/i}这边的说法毫无兴趣，那我就是在撒谎。

lines.en: : You’ve been right more often than not so far and...
lines.zh: : 迄今为止，你说对的时候比对错的时候多，而且……

lines.en: : And it’s always good to have somewhere to hide.
lines.zh: : 而且，有个地方能躲，总归是件好事。

lines.en: : So it begins...
lines.zh: : 就这样开始了……

lines.en: : After so long...it finally begins!
lines.zh: : 过了这么久……它终于开始了！

lines.en: : Please don’t make me regret this.
lines.zh: : 请别让我后悔。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : You won’t regret this {i}at all.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你{i}一点{/i}也不会后悔的。

lines.en: : You’ve saved yourself from ruin.
lines.zh: : 你把自己从毁灭中救了出来。

lines.en: scene yasueyesagain20
: But, I wonder...
lines.zh: : 不过，我在想……

lines.en: : Which domino will have to fall in your place?...
lines.zh: : 哪一块多米诺骨牌，得替你倒下呢？……

lines.en: scene black
I fall asleep on a stone pew in church so cold you would never know it’s summer.
lines.zh: 我在教堂里一条石头长凳上睡着了，冷得你绝不会相信现在是夏天。

lines.en: I don’t wake up until I’m halfway home.
lines.zh: 直到回家的路走了一半，我才醒过来。
